question: Can a traversal-conditioned C1 transition field qualify all 4773 sealed C08 frames while excluding non-incident geometry and preserving route identity?
method: Select the sealed traversal physical-tunnel field outside junction windows. Within each unchanged 1.10x window blend selected-layer and incident-union signed distances using weight 1-(3u^2-2u^3), u=r/R, giving incident union at the node and exact selected-layer value/first-order agreement at the sphere. Optimize only window frames and audit all frames at 0.10/0.05/0.025m. Extract one non-authoritative visualization patch per window, incident physical layer and resolution.
baseline: The single global union failed because non-incident tunnel135 stole S10 tunnel3 support; the hard layered switch passed isolation but failed all 25 seams. The only fallback is sealed FAIL evidence; do not weaken seam/safety/continuity gates or retry.

user_authorization.scope: One non-overwrite C08 V6 continuous-layered materialization and complete three-resolution qualification; zero LiDAR/model/checkpoint/graph/C09/C10/M-TARE.
user_authorization.confirmation_reference: After the exact hard-switch seam failure and recommended parameter-free continuous transition were presented, the user replied '继续'.

acceptance_criteria: Exactly 3 worlds, 312 edges, 624 directed traversals, 624 typed arc endpoints, 25 windows (4/7/14), 50 window-layer identities and 4773 frame identities are preserved.

All windows pass non-overlap, exact C1 transition seam and non-incident exclusion at 0.10/0.05/0.025m; exactly 150 per-layer patches have zero remaining degenerate triangles and zero nonmanifold edges after deterministic sanitation.
All 4773 frames pass horizontal>=0.8m, down in [0.95,1.05]m and up>=0.8m at all resolutions with identical pass/fail vectors and existing continuity limits.
Exactly 10309680 horizontal and 42957 vertical field rays are audited; address space <=4 GiB, wall time <=12h and result <=12 GiB.
Inference, graph updates, training, C09/C10 and M-TARE reads remain zero; logs, hashes, metrics, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal are complete.
stop_conditions: Any input/tool/environment/count drift, incompatible window overlap, transition/seam/isolation error, remaining patch degeneracy/nonmanifold edge or evidence failure.
Any resolution-dependent result, safety failure, continuity regression, resource breach or forbidden read.
Any radius/window/resolution/threshold change, trajectory reorder, frame deletion, favourable-resolution selection or retry.
expected_evidence: 150 transition-field patch records with layer identity, seam, dispatch, grid, sanitation and integrity metrics.
Three corrected trajectories, one 4773-row audit, three complete XY/XZ/safety figures and per-resolution metrics.
Frozen sidecar identity, command, raw log, runner metrics, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU only, 4 GiB RAM cap, zero GPU.
